title: A Bell for the Well
author: Isandro Pemberton
blurb: Paloma Galloway, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
